# Sound Cocktail — full details

> Sound Cocktail is a free ambient sound mixer. Mix 22 white noise and ambient sounds — rain, fire, café voices, night train, piano — and save your cup for sleep, focus or unwinding. No app to install, no account needed to start mixing. Optional one-time sound packs unlock extra channels.

## What it is

Sound Cocktail is a web app for mixing ambient sounds the way you mix a cocktail: pick a few sounds, set each one's level with a fader, and save the mix as a recipe. Sounds come from three sources: live field recordings, instrument samples, and a live synthesis engine with per-sound tuning (brightness, distance, density). The interface is hand-drawn and cute — a watercolor cocktail glass that fills as you mix.

- [放松白噪音](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/relax): 篝火、风和一点钢琴，给一天最后一小时的慢声音。
- [Rain sounds](https://soundcocktail.app/en/rain): Rain on a window with a stream underneath — the plainest mix, and the most-played.
- [雨声](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/rain): 窗边的雨，下面一条溪流，站里最简单、也最多人听的配方。

- [音源与授权](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/sources): 每个声音的出处：真实录音、乐器采样与实时合成，附作者与授权说明。

## Sounds (22)

Nature: rain, wind, waves, stream, thunder, birds, insects, fire, forest.
Places: café voices, traffic, night train, rural night, market, rainy street, boat cabin, keyboard taps.
Instruments: piano, guitar, wind chimes, wooden fish & drum, harp notes.

## Sound packs (one-time purchase, no subscription)

- Focus Pack ($1.99 / ¥6): market voices, wooden fish & drum, wind chimes.
- Sleep Pack ($2.99 / ¥9): insects, night train, harp notes, forest, boat cabin.
- Rain Night Pack ($3.99 / ¥12): thunder, rainy street.

Payment follows the visitor's region: China pays in CNY via Alipay; elsewhere pays in USD via Waffo. The interface language (English / 中文) is independent of payment — switching language never changes the price or payment method.

## Facts

- Free mixing works without an account. Accounts (email or Google) are only needed to buy packs and keep entitlements.
- Sound Cocktail is made by an independent developer. It is not a medical product and does not treat insomnia, anxiety or tinnitus — it is for winding down, focusing and relaxing.
- Real field recordings on the site are listed with their source and license on the site's sources section.
